newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen on bearish trend.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen on bearish trend.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are likely to fall further on Tuesday amid deteriorating market sentiment, brokers said.

"The market may continue to fall. Investors are worried at continuing price falls without much rationale," said broker Sabbir Ahmed. Brokers said the market needed institutional support to boost the sentiment of small investors.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index dropped 38.12 points or 3.89 percent to 939.66 on a turnover of 38.4 million taka on Monday.
